name: Dublin Airport

runway.v: longest runway 10L/28R, 3,109 m long and 45 m wide (three runways in all)

noise.v: no general night closure was found, but the longest runway, 10L/28R, is not used for take-off or landing 23:00-07:00 except for safety and other listed reasons, and reverse thrust should not be used 23:00-06:00 local
noise.quote: Runway 10L-28R shall not be used for take-off or landing between 2300 hours and 0700 hours, except in cases of safety,

handling.v: passenger handling by Swissport, Sky Handling, Signature Flight Support (corporate), Universal Aviation (corporate), Aer Lingus and Fenix Logistics
handling.quote: Available from Swissport, Sky Handling, Signature Flight Support (Corporate), Universal Aviation (Corporate), Aer Lingus and Fenix Logistics.

deicing.v: de-icing on request from Swissport and Aer Lingus
deicing.quote: On request from Swissport and Aer Lingus

slots.v: slot-coordinated (Level 3) airport: no operator may fly to or from Dublin without first obtaining a slot from Airport Coordination Ltd (ACL), the designated coordinator
slots.quote: Dublin Airport is a slot-coordinated airport. Operators must obtain approval for all proposed services at Dublin Airport. No Operator shall operate to or from Dublin without having first obtained a slot from Airport Coordination Ltd. (ACL), which is the designated airport coordinator.

missing: curfew (no explicit 'no curfew' statement; only a runway-specific night rule, recorded under noise)
notes: Edition: Irish eAIP effective 14 May 2026, the newest found online; a later AIRAC may be in force. The 10L/28R night rule applies to that runway only, so it is recorded under noise, not curfew. US Customs and Border Protection preclearance is by prior negotiation (0700-1700). dublinairport.com had no official GA/business-aviation page found by search. | 2026-10-30 run: AirNav Ireland lists the eAIP of 29 OCT 2026 as current, but that edition (index and AD 2 EIDW page) could not be opened; the newest EIDW page read was valid from 06 AUG 2026 (AIRAC Amdt 009/26, eff. 03 Sep 2026, changed only AD 2.22 for EIDW). In that edition AD 2.2 names no operator and AD 2.20 has no slot, PPR, general-aviation or general night-curfew text; size limits found are per taxiway/apron only (e.g. TWY K Code E, A340 prohibited on TWY K), so max_aircraft stays missing. Operator: the daa 'Dublin Airport Charges 2026' terms (effective 29 Mar 2026 - 27 Mar 2027) say 'daa plc ("daa") is involved in airport management' and 'In Ireland, it is currently responsible for the management of Cork and Dublin airports.' Slots: added from those terms and ACL's FAQ list (Level 3). The terms do not say separately how business aviation requests slots; check with ACL. ACL's DUB W26 parameters PDF had no GA text. Curfew: no explicit night-curfew or 'no curfew' statement found in AIP or daa terms; the North Runway planning night-flight conditions were not researched from an official source and are not recorded. Status set to verified: runway, customs (H24) and hours (H24) are recorded from the AIP; curfew is still listed as missing.
